summary: Feed s112_double to NDR is degraded: VLAN 20 is missing (50% packets untagged) and 93.99% encrypted traffic exceeds NDR 90% tolerance. No duplicates, drops, overload or one-way traffic issues detected.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP/SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or trunk allowed-VLAN list is incomplete. 50% of packets arrive untagged and required VLAN 20 is never observed, indicating VLAN preservation is disabled on the broker egress to the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires VLANs 10 and 20 for segmentation-aware detection. Missing VLAN 20 blinds the NDR to ~50% of traffic, breaks VLAN-based policies and misses lateral movement and east-west attacks in VLAN 20.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tag preservation on TAP/SPAN and packet broker egress so VLAN 20 is forwarded intact to the NDR and detection coverage is complete.

findings.root_cause: Traffic mix is 93.99% encrypted bytes, exceeding the NDR's 90% tolerance. No broker-side TLS decryption or selective forwarding is in place, so payload remains opaque to the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep packet inspection and behavioral analysis. With 94% encrypted, payload inspection, file extraction and content-based detection are ineffective, reducing coverage for encrypted C2, exfiltration and malware.

recommended_fix.why: NDR cannot analyze encrypted payload at this share; provide broker-based TLS inspection or key sharing / metadata enrichment to bring visible payload below 90% threshold and restore detection.
